title: LOK SABHA SPEAKER PAYS TRIBUTES TO FORMER SPEAKER, LOK SABHA, SHRI G.M.C. BALAYOGI
body_text:
Lok Sabha Speaker Shri Om Birla paid floral tributes at the portrait of former Speaker, Lok Sabha, Shri G.M.C. Balayogi in the Central Hall of Samvidhan Sadan, on his Birth Anniversary, today.
Deputy Chairman, Rajya Sabha Shri Harivansh, Members of Parliament, former Members and other dignitaries also paid tributes at the portrait of Shri Balayogi on this occasion.
Secretary-General, Lok Sabha, Shri Utpal Kumar Singh; and Secretary-General, Rajya  Sabha, Shri P C Mody also paid tributes to Shri Balayogi in the Central Hall of Samvidhan Sadan.
Shri Balayogi was the Speaker of the Twelfth Lok Sabha and he was re-elected the Speaker of the Thirteenth Lok Sabha as well.
The portrait of Shri Balayogi was painted by Shri Him Chatterjee. It is placed in the Outer Lobby, Samvidhaan Sadan  and was unveiled by the then  President of India Shri Pranab  Mukherjee on 10th February , 2014.
